items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And some of the members went with Adrian Rollini, New Yorkers. Remember them? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: That's how that - they became, you and Adrian Rollini got together somehow.
Yeah. That's why I got Adrian Rollini here.
I don't remember the exact facts there but from that grew his contracts with radio and television.
